measured_on: Intel Core Ultra 9 285H, x86-64, single P-core
key_findings: Two structurally different analysers, a statistical timing test (dudect) and a dynamic-taint checker (timecop), both detect the secret-dependent branch control and stay clean on the constant-time controls.

timecop is INAPPLICABLE to KyberSlash by construction: it detects secret-branch but not variable-latency-op. This is the exact capability gap that made the KyberSlash authors patch valgrind, and here it is a computed fact from the tool's declared capabilities, not an assertion.
dudect is applicable to KyberSlash's channel but MISSES it on x86-64: the 16-bit division's latency variation is below threshold on this divider. The published attack needs the Arm Cortex-A7.
applicability_is_computed: Applicability keys on the MECHANISM a pair exhibits (secret-branch, variable-latency-op, timing-observation) against the mechanisms a tool detects, not on the attacker's observable channel. A timing tool and a taint tool see the same branch through different lenses, so both are applicable to it; neither is applicable to an observation-only pair with no runnable program.
recall_status: No recall over the deployed recall-eligible pairs is reportable, and the reason is now two reasons rather than one. THREE such pairs carry no analyser row: Minerva and TPM-FAIL are observation-only, so every code-running analyser is inapplicable for want of a program to run; libgcrypt-minerva is a real two-build library that this corpus builds and times, and it carries no row because no analyser's declared mechanism intersects the one it exhibits, its deployed fix sitting in the secure-nonce signing path rather than in the public primitive an analyser drives. The only deployed pair with a detectable in-binary mechanism (KyberSlash) is tier C. This is a real structural gap, recorded rather than papered over: closing it needs Arm acquisition, an adapter that applies a statistical test to recorded traces, or an analyser that can be pointed at a signing path. An earlier revision of this field said 'both such pairs', which predates libgcrypt-minerva joining the corpus and understated the gap by one.
